why: Upstream Git LFS refuses to serve the pinned commit's bundle objects: HTTP 403, 'This repository exceeded its LFS budget.' Measured on 2026-08-20 both from a Colab runtime and from the development machine, so it is an upstream fact and not a property of either network.
primary_path: uv sync --all-groups --frozen, against the upstream git source
built_from: the uv git cache checkout of the pinned commit on the development machine, whose LFS objects were fetched while upstream still served them
identity_check: Each bundle's sha256 is its Git LFS object id, so a bundle that matches here is the object upstream names at that commit. Both match the objects installed on the development machine.
